requirements: Each transit family must have distinct gravity-sensitivity, miscalculation, efficiency-loss, route-hazard and emergency de-transit behavior.
Near sufficiently large gravity wells, imposed spacetime manipulation becomes progressively harder and may become inadmissible rather than merely expensive.
Gravitational shear and lensing planes create route geography; branch or fork conditions can become destructive for lane-coupled methods.
Safety sensing, prediction horizon, redundancy and emergency intervention capability must advance with transit maturity.

Range, speed and efficiency improvements must be causally attributable to mathematical, field-control, material, structural, energy, navigation, scale/distribution, control, recovery or infrastructure advances rather than unexplained tier bonuses.
The same resolved technology record must support engineering, educational, manual, scientific-history and provenance views.
